parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.name as project_name, p.project_type, p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, p.location_city, p.location_province, (SELECT row_to_json(b.*) FROM briefings b WHERE b.project_id = p.id AND b.status = 'approved' ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as briefing, (SELECT row_to_json(d.*) FROM design_options d WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND d.is_selected = true LIMIT 1) as design_option FROM projects p WHERE p.id = $1::uuid
SELECT content, model_recommended, temperature FROM agent_prompts WHERE agent_name = 'agent_accessibility' AND prompt_type = 'system' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_accessibility', 'running', NOW()) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO accessibility_audits (project_id, version, applies_to_project, applies_justification, overall_compliance, compliance_issues, recommendations, commercial_argumentation, content_json, status, execution_id, exec_status) VALUES ($1::uuid, 1, $2::boolean, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7, $8::jsonb, 'draft', $9::uuid, 'confirmed') RETURNING id
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO project_intelligence (project_id, agent_name, key, value) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_accessibility', 'audit_completed', $2::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (project_id, agent_name, key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = NOW()

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Parse Response').first().json.project_id, JSON.stringify({audit_id: $('Save Audit').first().json.id, applies: $('Parse Response').first().json.applies_to_project, compliance: $('Parse Response').first().json.overall_compliance, issues_count: JSON.parse($('Parse Response').first().json.compliance_issues).length})] }}
